title: PAN-OS: User Impersonation through GlobalProtect Portal

problem.value:
Authentication bypass vulnerabilities in the GlobalProtect™ portal and gateway of Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS® software enables an unauthenticated user to bypass security restrictions and establish an unauthorized VPN connection.

Panorama, Cloud NGFW, and Prisma® Access are not affected by this vulne

solution.value:
VERSION           MINOR VERSION                SUGGESTED SOLUTION
Cloud NGFW                                     No action needed.
PAN-OS 12.2       12.2.0 through 12.2.4-h*     Upgrade to 12.2.4-h2 or later.
PAN-OS 12.1       12.1.8 through 12.1.10-h*    Upgrade to 12.1.10-h4 or later.

work_around.value: No known workarounds exist for this issue.

title: Informational Bulletin: Precautionary Fixes for Non-Exploitable OSS CVEs in PAN-OS

problem.value: The Palo Alto Networks Product Security Assurance team has evaluated the following open source software (OSS) CVEs as they relate to PAN-OS. These CVEs were determined to have no impact on PAN-OS, but they have been fixed out of an abundance of caution.

solution.value: The OSS CVEs are fixed in the respective PAN-OS versions.

problem.value:
A vulnerability exists whereby an authenticated user can inject arbitrary shell commands using the device management command line interface.  (Ref #30122)
This vulnerability can result in arbitrary command execution, and can result in total compromise of the device.
This issue affects PAN-OS 4.0.3 a

solution.value: PAN-OS 4.0.4 and later; PAN-OS 3.1.10 and later.

work_around.value: This issue affects the management interface of the device.  Security appliance management best practices dictate that the management interface be isolated and strictly limited only to security administration personnel.
